name: EPIC 211302061
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 6.9 solar radii and 0.93 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211302061 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM radius (solar radii) 6.931078 (16th-84th percentiles 6.711974-7.180936), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211302061: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4710.594 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211302061 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 1340.117188 (16th-84th percentiles 1303.085938-1379.277344), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = -0.05 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 1,340 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 0.93 solar masses and 6.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,711 K at its surface.
